requirements_trace.section: Rule A35 — Scope The Check To The Claim
requirements_trace.claim: The parent-traversal trust check must be scoped to what traversal actually requires (execute), not what the lane's own directories require (write)
evidence: spoolOwnerTrusted renamed groupWritable->groupAccessOK; checkSpoolDir's parent-traversal gate now passes pst.Mode().Perm()&0o010 (group-execute) instead of &0o020 (group-write)
laneModesFromRoot (spool.go) still requires group-write (0o020) to derive the widened 0770/0640 modes for the lane's OWN directories/files, which genuinely are written to

requirements_trace.claim: Trust decision (stat) and the writes that follow it must resolve against the same filesystem object, not be re-derivable via an independent path walk
evidence: openLaneRoot opens os.Root once and derives dirMode/fileMode/trustGID from that same descriptor (Lstat("."))
mkdirTrustedIn/acquireSlotIn/writeAtomicRoot all resolve relative to the same *os.Root
